reviews.title: Latest release broken
reviews.text: I have been using this app for a long time, but the latest release crashes instantly every time I try to use it. The app help leads to a “not found” page on their site and an email sent to a general email address was ignored. If they fix the app and contact me, I may change the rating, but for now, this app doesn’t work, so the rating is deserved.

reviews.title: Not reliable
reviews.text:
The biggest issue of all is that it on one recent trip, it could not find my confirmed flight despite TripIt, Flighty, United (the airline for the flight), Flightradar24, FlightAware all able to find my flight.   I contacted support and they appreciated my ticket and also wanted screenshots of all flight tracking apps I use for that flight, and I obliged.   No follow up from support after 10 days. 

Also, as of May 30, 2026, the app will not launch on my iOS 26.5 iPhone 15 Pro Max.  Constantly crashes while it goes through its time-consuming launch screen sequence.   Tried uninstalling and reinstalling but it still won’t launch. 

When it works and is able to find my flights, it works very well. 

I’ve canceled my premium subscription.   I need 100% reliability in finding flights.

reviews.title: Once Great-No More
reviews.text:
I’ve had this app for quite some time and was always happy with it until now. Every time I open the app, it crashes. I’ve deleted and reinstalled it 3x and rebooted my iPhone each time. No change. 

I attempted to get support from the developer and that was not possible. 

My subscription expires in April 2027 so I’m out of luck as I have a useless dead app.

reviews.title: Garbage Marketing
reviews.text: The second you open this app they want a 5 star review. It’s like the fast food joint who wants a tip before they even finish taking your order let alone do anything close to worth of a tip. Thats the first red flag. Second is everything is pay, even the free trial is 3 days then monthly charge. You cannot see anything past this screen. So in order to know if there is anything even remotely worthy of paying you have to agree, sign up, look, then go and cancel the subscription. Is it too much to ask these apps not pull this garbage hoping we will sign up and forget so they can keep collecting money?!?! I am clearly a cranky old man, accepted. But I refuse to accept it makes me wrong. There are other apps that do the same thing better and at my age perhaps more importantly, more transparent.

reviews.title: Caution to subscribers
reviews.text: I subscribed to this app and almost immediately after I sent my payment info, there were three unauthorized transactions made from my bank account, totaling $300 +. I hadn’t used my card for a couple of weeks prior to that, so I know that it was connected to this purchase. Had to have my debit card blocked, had to get a new one, all of that. What the actual f is going on?
